cd /tmp/ws && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import parse

# Test actual parsing/searching behavior with alignment
tests = [
    # (pattern, string, expected_result)
    ("{:<}", "hello", "hello"),  # Left align - should match full word
    ("{:^}", " hello ", "hello"),  # Center align - should match without whitespace
    ("{:5}", "hello world", "hello world"),  # Right align default - should work
    ("{:10}", "hello", None),  # Width 10 - need at least 10 chars
    ("{:.5}", "hello world", "hello"),  # Precision 5
    ("{:<5}", "hello world", "hello"),  # Left align width 5
]

for pattern, string, expected in tests:
    p = parse.compile(pattern)
    r = p.search(string)
    result = r[0] if r else None
    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {pattern!r} on {string!r}: got {result!r}, expected {expected!r}")
PYEOF
